checks: Evaluation plans require successful real preflight-r2 result/status and exact route-specific exported target/cohort hashes.

Binder uses unmodified canonical_plan excluding only nonauthor_gate/formal_approved, exact all deployed Python map, real PREFLIGHT_GATE_PASS receipt, content-addressed review and authorization uploads.

Attention plans require accepted completed evaluation for the domain/route/condition, matching checkpoint/SID/config, and hash-bound evaluation result/status/independent review. Binder verifies matching accepted evaluation review and uploads exact review bytes.
Each formal validator independently verifies gate, plan digest, every deployed Python byte hash, source review and fixed asset hashes before any model test.
These orchestration scripts are outside deployed model Python dirs and do not change model, randomization, generation, evaluator, inputs or statistical formulas.
limit: Static program review; actual bind/deploy/runner receipt and final GitHub publication require separate runtime identity checks. The real evaluation preflight gates are separately saved for all six plans.
